name: playwright-repro
description: A discipline for fixing web bugs with throwaway Playwright scripts: reproduce the bug in a script before diagnosing it, measure against ground truth instead of assuming, apply the smallest fix, then re-run the same script to prove it. Includes a copy-ready script template, recipes for auth reuse, console/network capture, in-page state reads and pixel checks, and the measurement traps that make a script lie to you.
